## Verdict

missing

## Bearer

RaceDetailViewModel — app-phone/src/main/java/com/mgilli/hyroxtracker/ui/racedetail/RaceDetailViewModel.kt, buildRow

## Trigger

Opening the race detail screen, through the `uiState` combine that calls `toUiState` → `buildCycles` → `buildRow` — observed

## Today

`buildRow` (line 174) looks up each of the 30 indices with
`race.segments.first { it.index == index }`. `RaceRepositoryImpl.saveRecordedRace`
(core-data/src/main/kotlin/com/mgilli/core/data/race/RaceRepositoryImpl.kt,
lines 97-103) stores an INCOMPLETE race by filtering `segments` down
to `it.durationMs != null` before persisting — a segment never reached
is absent from the stored `Race.segments` list, not present with a
null `durationMs`. For any such index, `first { }` throws
`NoSuchElementException`, and the whole detail screen crashes. The
test fixture `race(...)` in RaceDetailViewModelTest.kt always builds
its segments through `buildSegments((1..30).map { ... })`
(core-domain/src/main/kotlin/com/mgilli/core/domain/race/SegmentBuilder.kt),
which always returns exactly 30 `Segment` entries — a null entry in
its input becomes a `Segment` with `durationMs = null`, never an
absent entry. No existing test builds a `race.segments` list shorter
than 30, so the crash path is untested.

## Expected

`buildRow` looks up the segment for `index` without assuming it is
present, and when none is found renders the same row it already
renders for a segment whose `durationMs` is null: duration and
cumulative both showing the missing-value glyph, no delta. Opening
the detail screen for any INCOMPLETE race — one stopped before its
30th segment — renders without crashing, all indices past the last
reached one showing as missing.
